hints: The chain is sorted, so equal values sit next to each other. What does that let you decide by looking only at a link and the one after it?
Whether a run has started. If `current.val == current.next.val`, the whole run of that value has to go - so skip forward past all of it.
Keep a reference to the last link you decided to *keep*. After skipping a run, point that link at whatever comes after the run.
The head can be removed, so the 'last kept link' has nowhere to live at the start. A dummy link in front of the head gives it one.
